messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT: Elevated 5xx & timeout rate detected for tenant marinerai on Dedicated cluster us-west-2a. Spike start ~2024-07-10T15:48:08Z. Error breakdown: 502 gateway, 504 timeout, upstream 5xx from model-proxy. Current 5xx rate 11.8% (baseline 0.3%). Affected route(s): /v1/generate (primary). Paging oncall.
oncall-amy: Ack, I'm on it. Pulling up dashboards and logs now. Anyone seeing KV evictions or queue backpressure?
sre-jordan: I see KV eviction noise on pool-4 and worker queue length climbing. Gateway logs show upstream conn resets to model-proxy for marinerai.
eng-runtime-tessa: Confirming, traces show long tail latencies and spikes of model-proxy 502s originating from the same node set in pool-4.
eng-infra-li: Pool-4 telemetry: GPU util ~98%, inflight queue > 950 reqs, KV eviction rate elevated. Looks like noisy tenant behavior or sudden traffic surge from marinerai.
cs-lin: I'm drafting a customer note to MarinerAI. Need ETA on mitigation steps.
oncall-amy: Quick mitigation plan (1) route marinerai to fallback pool-2 with spare capacity, (2) apply temporary per-tenant concurrency cap (3) scale pool-4 by +2 GPUs, (4) enable model-variant fallback to smaller quantized variant for a fraction of traffic. If agreeable I'll execute steps 1-3 now.
eng-runtime-tessa: Applying route override now: `infractl routes set --tenant marinerai --pool pool-2 --priority 100` — will push and verify.
sre-jordan: Tailing gateway logs for a live snippet:

```
2024-07-10T15:50:10Z gateway[proxy]: upstream reset conn id=0x7f "POST /v1/generate" tenant=marinerai status=502 rt=123ms
2024-07-10T15:50:12Z serving[worker]: kv_cache_eviction tenant=marinerai keys_evicted=1200 node=pool-4
2024-07-10T15:50:35Z gateway[proxy]: timeout to upstream tenant=marinerai route=/v1/generate status=504 rt=30001ms
```

Looks like memory/kv churn leading to timeouts during heavy concurrency.
eng-infra-li: Kicking off scale: `infractl scale --pool pool-4 --delta 2` — job queued; expected provisioning ~3-6 minutes depending on capacity.
oncall-amy: Applying per-tenant concurrency cap: `rlctl set --tenant marinerai --concurrency 8` — applying now (temporary).
eng-runtime-tessa: Route override completed at 2024-07-10T15:53:20Z by eng-runtime-tessa. Confirmed 90% of marinerai traffic now hitting pool-2. infractl returned 200.
incident-bot: deploy-bot: route-change applied by eng-runtime-tessa (job id rc-7782). scale job queued id scale-990.
cs-lin: Customer message draft: "We're aware of an elevated error rate impacting generate endpoints; we've routed your traffic to fallback capacity and applied temporary limits. Expect improved response within 5-15 minutes. We'll follow up with a post-incident summary." Should I send?
product-maya: Send now. Also note product impact: realtime infer endpoints may have dropped availability; logging for severity.
oncall-amy: Observability update: after route override 5xx dropped from 11.8% -> 6.2%. Still above baseline. Scaling and throttle in flight.
sre-jordan: Also enabled 20% model-variant fallback (smaller quant) for marinerai to reduce memory/KV pressure: `modelctl rollout --tenant marinerai --variant quant-4bit --traffic 20%` — rollout started.
eng-infra-li: Scale job completed at 2024-07-10T15:58:50Z. Pool-4 +2 GPUs live. Watching queue lengths.
oncall-amy: After scale + route + throttle, 5xx down to 2.4%. Latency improving.
oncall-nate: Taking handoff from amy at 16:00. Summary for next shift: route override -> pool-2 applied; per-tenant concurrency cap 8 enforced; pool-4 scaled +2 GPUs; model fallback 20% enabled. Customer notified. Monitoring.
oncall-amy: Handing off: all mitigation actions applied and verified. I'll update incident doc and assign followups.
sre-jordan: Current status: 5xx ~1.1% now, close to baseline. Will keep monitoring for recurrence. Observed a correlated spike in marinerai's job submission rate around 15:47 which looks like a client-side burst.
cs-lin: Sent customer update at 16:03. MarinerAI replied: "Thanks — we'll throttle client retries on our side and send logs." Good.
product-maya: Please add to postmortem: check whether tenant-level autoscale triggers earlier and whether we should add soft concurrency caps by default for new tenants.
eng-runtime-tessa: Quick note: we need a more automated reroute when pool kv_eviction_rate > threshold. Filed GH issue #RED-4521.
oncall-nate: Marking incident as MONITORED. Creating short post-incident checklist in the incident doc and routing followups.
sre-jordan: Post-incident followups (owners):
- tighten KV eviction thresholds + alerting (owner: eng-runtime-tessa)
- adjust autoscale policy for pool-4 (owner: eng-infra-li)
- add runbook section for per-tenant throttle and quick route override (owner: cs-lin)
- investigate client burst pattern and recommend retry/backoff to MarinerAI (owner: cs-lin)
- consider default soft concurrency caps for newly onboarded tenants (owner: product-maya)

I'd estimate followups ETA 1 week for initial mitigations.
cs-lin: I'll coordinate SLA credit conversation if needed and own the customer postmortem comms.
incident-bot: :white_check_mark: INCIDENT RESOLVED -> MONITORED by oncall-nate at 2024-07-10T16:25:50Z. Thread archived for postmortem.
oncall-nate: Closing handoff notes: will continue to monitor for 2 hours then close. Thanks everyone for fast coordination. :pray:
summary: Elevated 5xx/timeouts for MarinerAI tenant on Dedicated cluster us-west-2a. Mitigations: routing override to fallback pool, temporary per-tenant concurrency cap, scaled pool, enabled model-variant fallback. Customer notified. 5xx rate reduced from 11.8% -> ~1.1%. Post-incident followups created.
